scope: All inventoried PE linkage and retained top-level JSONL native dossiers under research/evidence and implementation/evidence; no fresh decompilation.
limits: Index coverage is not full semantic recovery or original source.
Repeated dossiers include retained copies; occurrences are not analysis runs.
JSON-only/native-instruction evidence without top-level pseudocode is outside the native-function count; remains in the reports and prior evidence.

Missing dossier image bases are bound from PE metadata by original SHA-256. Non-JSON logs with a JSONL suffix are retained separately; malformed lines in a file containing pseudocode dossiers fail acceptance.
Bundled module basename matches are candidates, not observed loader resolution.
Provider call edges do not close indirect/virtual calls or demonstrate execution.
UPK coverage is provided by the separate package map; native declarations are not implementations, and virtual package offsets are not compressed file offsets.
No original SHA revalidation performed by this index generator; independent streamed original-file validation is a separate gate.
